title: Steering Rigs
summary:
Hot Wheels Steering Rigs was a line of detailed semi tractor and trailer sets that were released in 1981 and 1982. On the back of the trailer, there was a large wheel on top which could be used to steer the rig. See detail below:
200px|left|thumb|Steering wheel detail.150px
200px
They were produced in two locations: Hong Kong and France.

title: Volkswagen 1:50 Scale Series
summary: The Volkswagen 1:50 Scale Series line was a short-lived series first released in 2008. The line featured six Volkswagen models in 1/50 scale that were highly detailed. All models came with rubber wheels with treads and featured numerous colorwaves in one year split over three different series: Off The Lot, Rat Rods and California Local.
